description: This file contains implementation of 'gn refs' command, which finds reverse dependencies and references for targets, files, and configs within a build system. It includes functions for dependency mapping, recursive printing of dependency trees, and command-line argument processing.

methods.name: FillDepMap
methods.description: Populates a dependency map with targets and their dependents.

methods.name: RecursivePrintTarget
methods.description: Recursively prints a target and its dependencies in tree form.

methods.name: RecursivePrintTargetDeps
methods.description: Recursively prints dependencies of a target.

methods.name: RecursiveCollectChildRefs
methods.description: Recursively collects all targets referencing a given target.

methods.name: RecursiveCollectRefs
methods.description: Finds all targets referencing a given target, including itself.

methods.name: RecursiveCollectChildRefs
methods.description: Helper for RecursiveCollectRefs, finds all targets referencing a target.

methods.name: TargetReferencesConfig
methods.description: Checks if a target references a specific config.

methods.name: GetTargetsReferencingConfig
methods.description: Finds targets referencing a specific config, optionally limited to default toolchain.

methods.name: DoTreeOutput
methods.description: Outputs a dependency tree for given targets.

methods.name: DoAllListOutput
methods.description: Outputs all dependencies recursively for given targets.

methods.name: DoDirectListOutput
methods.description: Outputs direct references to given targets.

methods.name: RunRefs
methods.description: Main function executing the 'gn refs' command, processing arguments, building dependency maps, and outputting results.
